'''Andrew John Trevor Miller''', born at [[Chesham]], [[Buckinghamshire]] on 30 May 1963, was a [[cricketer]] who played [[first-class cricket]] for [[Oxford University Cricket Club|Oxford University]] and [[Middlesex County Cricket Club|Middlesex]] in the mid-1980s.

Miller was a left-handed opening batsman and an occasional bowler. Having made his debut in one match for Oxford University in 1982, he was highly successful for both the university and his county in the 1983 season, making in total 1,002 runs in just 15 matches at a batting average of more than 43.<ref name="Millerseasons">{{cite web | url = https://cricketarchive.com/Archive/Players/12/12087/f_Batting_by_Season.html | title = First-class Batting and Fielding in Each Season by Andrew Miller |publisher = CricketArchive | accessdate = 2008-07-03}}</ref> He won a [[University sporting blue|Blue]] in that year and in the two following seasons, when he played less frequently. His only full season of county cricket was 1986, when he made 963 runs,<ref name="Millerseasons"/> but he left the first-class game at the end of the following season.

He later played [[Minor Counties]] cricket for [[Hertfordshire County Cricket Club|Hertfordshire]].
